name: lean-ctx-jobs
description: LeanCTX tool-call layer: wake Claude when lean-ctx background jobs finish, answer sleep-polls while a job is watched, and shape large native Bash output. Disabled in Code Mode sessions (lean-ctx claude-mod code-mode).

shape_native_output.title: Shape native Bash output
shape_native_output.description: Compress large native Bash stdout through lean-ctx (recoverable); off keeps it byte-for-byte.

wake_on_job_finish.title: Wake Claude when a lean-ctx background job finishes
wake_on_job_finish.description: Watch ctx_shell background jobs and start a turn when they finish (shown as a prompt from the lean-ctx-jobs plugin). Jobs finishing close together share one wake. Off: Claude checks a job's status itself.
